title: Ping An Finance Center
visualBrief: Shenzhen’s stainless-clad North Tower, tapering double-notched square sections, paired supercolumns, recessed braced corners, fine pointed facade piers, folded eastern canopy and genuinely open four-legged crown below its small glass pyramid.

nativeAxes.origin: Mapped North Tower envelope at reconstructed open-air entrance grade

reconstruction.massing: The exact-QID double-notched plan plus54 separately mapped facade/crown patches constrain lower narrowing, disappearing corner projections and upper taper. Their skillion tags encode sloped facade surfaces rather than solid occupied roof volumes. Completed KPF photographs establish the final599.1m design without the abandoned tall spire.
reconstruction.facade: Eight broad stainless column casings frame the recessed corner bays. Four broad glazed faces retain repeated pointed vertical piers, pane seals and horizontal floor courses; corner louvres and large diagonal bands remain physical geometry. The shared stainless surface approximates the supplied embossed linen finish at world-viewer scale.
reconstruction.crown: A glazed sloping roof closes the upper occupied volume, then four separate stainless legs continue around large open apertures. The small square cap starts near590m and converges to599.1m, following the completed architect close aerial and mapped roof patches.
reconstruction.entry: The eastern Yitian Road facade uses the architect’s completed street photograph: splayed braces, low folded canopy, dark granite feet and three round revolving door enclosures. Fine dimensions and door offsets are photograph reconstructions.

geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.
sourceLicense: Original reconstruction under repository license. Map-derived plan evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications are linked, not redistributed.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Original245790-triangle/28274144-byte master remains byte-reproducible from unchanged recipe. Reviewed source uses full backing glass/steel faces, merged pointed pier spans, continuous facade seals and sparse physical steel joints/louvres instead of repeated framed pane islands. Double-notched taper, eight supercolumn casings, seven mechanical-band intervals, recessed diagonal strips, sloping glazed roof, four separate open crown legs, small pyramid, eastern folded canopy, splayed braces and three revolving doors retained. Skyline omits separate piers, braces, joints, louvres and fine tip/entry frames, averaging shared steel/stone colours into one group. District restores sampled piers and coarse recessed braces; street restores all nine face piers, aggregate seams/louvres and roof/door grids; close-up restores fine seams/louvres and32-sided doors within64000triangles. Original fine repeat density is preserved through original recipe, not every small master component in reviewed source. Canonical stainless and granite graphs approximate Deco Linen steel and dark stone; coated canopy/recess shares steel/glazing respectively to keep three near draws. Zero embedded images. Individual dimensions/roof datums/door offsets are reconstructions; finite along-ray1.5/.75/.3/.1m comparisons exclude intentionally omitted narrow seams/louvres/piers/braces, not a global surface-distance bound. Physical-device performance and surveyed grade unmeasured.
importReason: Preserve thin facade frames, panel joints and crown/antenna details until a measured LOD chain is authored.
